en.Esse vulcão solta fogo azul! E o último: This volcano spits out blue fire! And the last fact is the worst.
en.É o Kawah Ijen, na Indonésia. Segue a Ma: It's Kawah Ijen, in Indonesia. Follow Maia, it gets worse: the blue is sulfur gas catching fire, at up to six hundred degrees Celsius.
en.Na cratera tem o maior lago muito ácido: Its crater holds the world's biggest super acidic lake, almost as acidic as battery acid.
en.E mesmo assim, mineiros descem lá pra ti: And still, miners go down there for sulfur and climb back up carrying up to ninety kilos, about two hundred pounds, on their backs.
